notes.title: [Version 1.02 Update] Addition of "Jewel Spirits Encyclopedia" and more
notes.content: [p]Hello! This is developer Iroha.[/p][p]Thank you for enjoying "Gewel Spirits."[/p][p]We are pleased to announce the first update since release. The contents are as follows:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[New Features][/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Added the "Gem Spirit Encyclopedia."[/b][/p][p]You can now view a list and details of unlocked gem spirits in both the title and battle maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Data Transmission Rejection" setting in "Configuration."[/p][/*][*][p]The backlog can now be closed with the Confirm or Cancel key.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Balance Adjustments][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Lapis Lazuli's "Possession" state has been strengthened. Attack power multiplier increased from 50% to 75%.[/p][/*][*][p]Citrine's "Bye-Bye Blast" has been strengthened. Attack power multiplier increased from 50% to 75%[/p][/*][*][p]Weakened the multiplier of the AOE attack of the 1st floor boss "Poison Thread Witch" (from 100% to 75%)[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved cases where there were too many/too few shop spaces[/p][/*][*][p]Added a limit to prevent ineffective treasures from appearing on the 3rd floor[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Bug/Issue Fixes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Emerald's "Healing Mana" ability did not affect allies with full HP[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several other typos[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We plan to make more proactive balance adjustments based on user feedback and gameplay data. We hope you continue to enjoy "Gewel Spirits."[/p]

tags.feature: Added a "Data Transmission Rejection" setting in "Configuration."
The backlog can now be closed with the Confirm or Cancel key.

tags.balance_change: Lapis Lazuli's "Possession" state has been strengthened. Attack power multiplier increased from 50% to 75%.
Citrine's "Bye-Bye Blast" has been strengthened. Attack power multiplier increased from 50% to 75%
Weakened the multiplier of the AOE attack of the 1st floor boss "Poison Thread Witch" (from 100% to 75%)
Added a limit to prevent ineffective treasures from appearing on the 3rd floor

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Emerald's "Healing Mana" ability did not affect allies with full HP
